series: What Passes Between Us / 在关系里，仍是自己 · SAE 关系论
scope: Eight complete reader essays: seven main essays and an optional guide, in independently written English, Simplified Chinese and derived Traditional Chinese. Not full translations of the technical papers or of paper 0's thirteen comparisons.
method: Read the Chinese source arguments and boundaries, with three authorized agents drafting papers 1–7. Lead authoring of the guide, cross-reading against all eight sources, and unified editorial review. Published HTTPS snapshots are byte-identical to the author's local source checkout. No translation service.
editorial_boundaries: Relations can be one-way, unacknowledged and brief. An actual identifiable effect between bearers is required; an imagined reply, diffuse causal influence or mere object is not silently made a second participant.

A relationship is not a third legislator. Its effects and recognized arrangements matter without creating a superior will. People's standing does not depend on mutual recognition being successfully realized.

Yesterday, today and tomorrow are temporal positions of one bearer, not three negotiating subjects. Only today's person acts; the future's present effect is a present projection, and reinterpretation does not alter historical events.

A genuinely self-originating restriction with no external source or assurance sustaining it is not automatically colonization. Operation can be blocked without transferring the person's standing to revise. Outside behavior cannot exhaustively certify a person's own grounds.

Promises bind through what one genuinely continues to stand by and effects already left in another's life. Revision or exit does not erase either history. This is a choice about normative sources, not a proof that every theory of directed obligations is false, and not a way to cancel institutional or legal requirements.

Reporting an intention is not by itself making a promise to the listener. Expectations and habits can be real without certifying tacit commitment. An expectation may be taken up or become an explicit role requirement, but its mere existence proves neither.

Responses are material, not automatic settlement. Expressing concern or offering a contestable interpretation is distinct from preempting the meaning of another's action so that denial cannot count as denial.

Mutual regard is read as a particular event, not a permanent personal or relational rank; no DD labels are used in the reader essays. An arranged smile cannot guarantee inner recognition, nor does a prior meeting arrangement rule it out. An encounter dependent on making a third person mere material does not certify recognition.

Cultivation and colonizing direction are local, potentially coexisting directions, not a net score for a relationship. Direction at the time and later completion are distinct. Calm, persistence, competence and later success do not certify freedom or justify earlier harm.

Natural dependency is not manufactured dependency that blocks refusal. Basic-rights violations are evaluated separately; relational understanding is not a replacement for protection or institutional handling.

Repair of injury and unresolved conflict are separate. Withdrawing participation can raise another's costs without by itself becoming an outward punitive operation. Additional punishment, isolation and preemptive definitions of what departure means require separate reading. Shared resources, third-party effects and institutional arrangements do not vanish on exit.

No obligation to enter or preserve a particular relation is asserted. Solitude does not diminish standing. Independent external questioning is functionally distinct from self-reflection, but openness does not require permanent access for a specific person. No behavioral or clinical test, diagnosis or stay/leave prescription is offered.

Relations as a theory shelf remain distinct from the everyday Relationships series, with explicit cross-links. The guide selects a few philosophical junctions and refers the complete thirteen dialogues to paper 0 rather than claiming to reproduce them all.
